summary: Round 4 (Stock Management + Payment Reminders) tested on backend and frontend. Backend: the new suite tests/test_round4_stock_reminders.py passes 18/18. Regression passes 48/48 after one stale assertion in test_round2_multitenant.py was updated: the Round 4 seed SAL/0004 for Late Payer in Gupta Oct 2026 adds 7.5 CGST and 7.5 SGST. Verified stock: CRUD; a case-insensitive duplicate name gives 400 on create and on update; on hand = opening + purchases + credit notes - sales - debit notes; editing a sale's qty updates on hand; cancelling restores stock; avg cost = (opening value + purchase amount) / qty; value is 0 when stock is negative; the low and negative flags and low_count work; movements give the opening, running balances and the closing, and from_date carries the opening forward; a bogus or foreign item_id gives 400; description and unit are auto-filled from the item; an item used in vouchers cannot be deleted (400), an unused one can, and its name can then be reused; business isolation returns 404 on PUT, DELETE and movements. Verified reminders: FIFO allocation of receipts to the oldest bills; ledger credit_days and the settings default_credit_days both drive the due date and days overdue; send creates a token and updates last_reminded_at and reminder_count; there is a 400 when nothing is overdue; a viewer gets 403 and an expired business gets 402; cross-tenant ledgers give 400; public /pay works without auth, returns no internal ids, and gives 404 on an invalid token; after full payment overdue and outstanding are 0, the customer drops off the list, and send gives 400; Trial Balance stays balanced. Frontend, using a fresh TEST business: Stock page create dialog, duplicate toast, row and on hand, movements dialog (opening 5 -> +10 -> -4 -> closing 11), low filter, dashboard alert-low-stock links to /stock. Voucher ItemPicker: a sales pick fills HSN 1514, sale rate 180 and GST 5%; a purchase pick fills purchase rate 140; the 'use text' option keeps a free-text item; item-0-stock-warning shows when qty is above on hand and hides at a valid qty; there is no warning on a credit note; on hand drops after saving. Reports Stock Summary tab shows the totals. Reminders page: the UPI warning shows when there is no UPI and hides after the UPI is set in Settings > Invoice Branding; the expand rows show the bills; the Remind popup was captured: api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=919812345678 with the overdue amount, the bill, due date and the /pay/<token> link; Last reminder updates to '1 sent'. The PayPage on mobile 390px shows the amount, the upi:// link (pa, pn, am, cu, tn), a QR, the bills, no horizontal overflow, and an inline error for a bad token; it shows 'No dues pending' after full payment. The ledger dialog credit days field persists (7). Settings company credit days shows 30. Gupta (read-only) Stock and Reminders pages and Trial Balance (balanced) checked. No page errors.

minor.issue: Code review: upd always includes gstin (blank if not sent) and gst_rates (the default list if not sent). Unlike upi_id and bank_ifsc, these are not guarded with model_fields_set, so a partial PUT (e.g. only default_credit_days) would wipe the GSTIN and custom GST rates. The UI sends the full body, so it is not hit today.
avg_cost counts only purchases. Debit notes (purchase returns) reduce on hand but not the cost basis. Acceptable for an MVP.
Tokens never expire or get revoked. Each Remind click creates a new token. Fine for now, but consider an expiry or index on reminders.token.

issues: The In and Out columns show only purchased_qty and sold_qty, not credit or debit notes. When there are returns, opening + In - Out does not equal On hand, which is confusing. Include returns, or rename the columns to Purchased and Sold.
The bill sub-rows don't line up with the headers. The due date shows under 'Overdue (₹)' and the 'Not due' or 'x days late' status shows under 'Oldest overdue'.
<a data-testid=pay-upi-link> wraps a <Button>, which nests interactive elements (invalid HTML). Use <Button asChild><a/></Button>.

action_items: Optional: guard gstin and gst_rates in PUT /settings with model_fields_set, like upi_id and bank_ifsc
Optional: make the Stock table In and Out columns include returns, or rename them
Optional: line up the Reminders expanded bill row cells with the column headers
critical_code_review_comments: stock.py: _moves aggregation and the unwind are correct and scoped to active vouchers. There is a vouchers index on (business_id, items.item_id). remove_item blocks deletion even if the only uses are cancelled vouchers. That is defensible.
routes_vouchers._prepare: unknown, foreign and inactive item_ids all give 400. Unit is always overwritten from the stock item, which is good.

reminders.py: FIFO is correct. Opening-balance bills are always treated as overdue with days_overdue null. A payment voucher refunding a customer (debit) is treated as a new bill, which is acceptable.
whatsapp.js sendReminder opens about:blank first, so the popup is not blocked. The phone number is normalised to 91XXXXXXXXXX.
